Salman Khan's Ganpati Aarti Moment with Sister Arpita Goes Viral

During the Ganpati visarjan ceremony at Sohail Khan's residence, actor Salman Khan performed the aarti. A moment captured showed his sister, Arpita Khan, subtly correcting him as he appeared to perform the ritual in the wrong direction, specifically anti-clockwise. The Khan family was present for the immersion of the Ganpati idol. Videos of the event, including the aarti moment, were shared online.
